{{Top}}
{{MultipleIssues|citation|image}}
'''Gas''' was a state of matter. Many gases such as [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] or [[Methane/Legends|methane]] were essential for living beings to thrive, however there existed lifeforms that could survive without the need of air, such as [[vacuumbreather]]s. Large [[Planet/Legends|planets]] known as [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] were common throughout the galaxy. Gas [[Mining/Legends|mining]] was a widespread industry in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Gas-based lifeforms were also known to exist, such as the [[Neo-Bespinian]]s.

Many kinds of gases could be found throughout the galaxy, including:
*[[Azetal]]
*[[Blaster gas/Legends|Blaster gas]]
*[[Cyanogen]]
*[[Dorin gas/Legends|Dorin gas]]
*[[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]]
*[[Prothium]]
*[[Sig/Legends|Sig]]
{{Science-stub}}
